Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.25.0 adds a project-created two-seat helicopter (item 941) with driver-only touch control, configurable bounded flight, gravity and hover response, automatic unpiloted landing, native body collision/save behavior, and independently animated main/tail rotor bones. It reuses the existing single-Mount two-seat role protocol; Android 7723 flight, save reload and real two-device multiplayer remain pending verification. v0.24.0 vehicle activation, v0.23.1 tint fix and all earlier vehicle/content fixes remain included.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
